title: Deprovisioning Your Device from Zscaler Client Connector in the Classic UI

blocks.text: This article provides information about the Classic UI version of the app available with Zscaler Client Connector versions earlier than 5.0. To learn more about the Modern UI version of the app available with Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0, see Using Zscaler Client Connector in the Modern UI.

After an admin soft removes your device from the Zscaler Admin Console, it can take an hour for the device to be completely removed. However, you can immediately remove the device from Zscaler Client Connector as an end user. When you remove a device, Zscaler Client Connector logs you out but does not uninstall the app from the device. To uninstall the app, see Uninstalling Zscaler Client Connector.
To remove a device from Zscaler Client Connector as an end user:

blocks.item: In Zscaler Client Connector, click More.
